# assessment criterion

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assessmentCriterion`](gmeow-assessmentCriterion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessmentCriterion>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The criterion applied. Functional: a 21-axis scoring pass is 21 Assessments (zeros included — a zero is a score, not an absence). Plays the [`observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) role without the subproperty axiom ([`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) pattern). An assessment names a criterion or a rubric, or both (SHACL).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Assessment`](../classes/gmeow-Assessment.md) -> [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:assessmentCriterion`](gmeow-assessmentCriterion.md) from [`gmeow:Assessment`](../classes/gmeow-Assessment.md) to [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

[`gmeow:Assessment`](../classes/gmeow-Assessment.md), [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on an [`Assessment`](../classes/gmeow-Assessment.md) to name the single criterion applied — one [`Assessment`](../classes/gmeow-Assessment.md) per criterion, zeros included.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one criterion per assessment (it is functional — split a multi-axis pass into one [`Assessment`](../classes/gmeow-Assessment.md) per axis) and avoid omitting both criterion and rubric (at least one is required — SHACL).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:assessmentCriterion`](gmeow-assessmentCriterion.md) once per assessment; it plays the [`observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) role without the subproperty axiom ([`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) pattern). Pair with [`gmeow:assessmentRubric`](gmeow-assessmentRubric.md) for version context.
